about_the_game:
BURGER, NO PLEASE! is an online co-op game for up to 4 players where you work in a fast-food restaurant and gather ingredients in the most absurd ways. Customers are waiting for their burgers, but regular deliveries are gone — you’ll have to find everything yourself.

Instead of simply opening the fridge, you’ll face unusual tasks: catch fish in a toilet, pour “cola” from a rusty tap, grab cheese from rats, or obtain a patty in a very unconventional way. Bring the ingredients back to the kitchen, assemble the order, and serve it to the customer while enjoying the chaos and humor of the process.

Play solo or invite friends to the online co-op to cook together, race for speed, and have fun in the crazy atmosphere of a burger joint.

Key features:

  • Online co-op for up to 4 players — cook together with friends.

  • Variety of ingredient gathering methods — from toilets to trash bins.

  • Bright and fun atmosphere with elements of dark humor.

  • Interactive kitchen and surrounding areas with plenty of amusing situations.
